wholePhysicalScope: Named Lands Department survey polygons and Hong Kong Principal Datum building heights, the unchanged 5-metre government terrain raster, and the original Qualla public-domain facade photograph.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the three halls, two courtyards, and layered upturned tile roofs.
limitations: Scope covers the three principal halls, surrounding walls and two internal courtyards. Exterior ancillary buildings outside the named survey polygons are separate.
The exact positions of the courtyard partitions, rear openings and individual ridge ornaments are visually estimated.
